verdict_rationale: Recommended pattern (config flag in kiosk.php + foodkingConfig.kioskPaymentRouteAllToCounter + skip UI in KioskPaymentComponent + force payment_method=CASH_ON_DELIVERY) is architecturally sound. ZERO §7 frozen-zone touch required. Backend already supports the routing semantics (is_counter_deferred_kiosk_cash at FrontendOrderService.php:206-208). Future Plan A transition is a single env flip (no code change).

architectural_decision.pattern: Config-flag-based frontend short-circuit + backend reuse of existing 'counter-deferred kiosk cash' branch

layer_separation.config_layer: config/kiosk.php — new key 'payment_route_all_to_counter' (env KIOSK_PAYMENT_ROUTE_ALL_TO_COUNTER, default true V1, will flip to false post-acquéreur-contract). Single source of truth.
layer_separation.blade_layer: resources/views/master.blade.php:132 — add ONE line to expose flag to window.foodkingConfig.kioskPaymentRouteAllToCounter. Already 14 other kiosk keys are exposed this way (kioskAutoLogin, kioskDefaultLocale, kioskLocaleSwitchAllowed, kioskMenuPricing, kioskSandwichSplit, kioskConfirmationAutoReturnSeconds, etc.). Established pattern.
layer_separation.frontend_layer: resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskPaymentComponent.vue (NOT frozen — confirmed grep of CLAUDE.md §7). Two surgical changes: (1) computed property planBActive that reads window.foodkingConfig?.kioskPaymentRouteAllToCounter, (2) in confirmPayment() at line 356, if planBActive then bypass selectMethod UI by forcing this.method='cash' before submitOrder call. UI optionally hides 'Carte' + 'Ticket Restaurant' tiles in template (v-if guarded — leaves DOM clean).
layer_separation.backend_layer: ZERO change. FrontendOrderService.php:186-208 already maps payment_method=1 (CASH_ON_DELIVERY) on a kiosk order to is_counter_deferred_kiosk_cash=true, which: (a) auto-accepts order so KDS receives it immediately, (b) leaves payment state UNPAID, (c) defers actual money capture to POS PosCounterCollectModal. This is the EXACT semantics the owner described.

architectural_decision.why_not_frontend_only: Frontend-only would work for V1 but leaves no audit/observability switch. Config-flag pattern (already used 14× in same blade) gives ops a single env knob to monitor + flip when terminals are wired, and the same flag is greppable in logs (FrontendOrderService:239-248 already logs is_kiosk_payment_method).
architectural_decision.why_not_backend_only: Backend-only enforcement (reject CARD/TR from kiosk machines) would force frontend to handle a 422 gracefully, doubling complexity. Backend stays semantically pure (it still SUPPORTS the 3 methods, but the kiosk surface CHOOSES to only emit cash). This is forward-compatible with Plan A: just flip the env and the same backend handles CARD/TR again without code change.

Pattern mirrors locale_switch_allowed (lines 31, 106, 190) — same dual-return-path discipline.

nf525_compliance_proof.pricing_ssot: PricingService.php (frozen) is NOT touched. The submitOrder flow at KioskPaymentComponent.vue:375 already sends only {item_id, quantity, option_ids} via buildKioskOrderPayload (kioskCart.js:160). Backend recalculates totals server-side at FrontendOrderService.php (post-line 258 unsets client-supplied total/subtotal/discount per [GAP-21-2] comment line 255-258). Plan B does NOT introduce any frontend price computation. Compliant.
nf525_compliance_proof.audit_chain: AuditLogService.php (frozen) is NOT touched. The order creation path still goes through DB::transaction at FrontendOrderService.php:177 — same path as today's kiosk-cash flow. HMAC chain extension is unchanged. The counter-deferred-cash path (is_counter_deferred_kiosk_cash=true line 206) already exists and is in production today — Plan B simply makes ALL kiosk orders take that path. ZERO new audit-chain code surface. Compliant.
nf525_compliance_proof.composition_snapshot: composition_snapshot JSON is created at order-creation time inside DB::transaction (FrontendOrderService.php:177-237 closure). Plan B does not modify what is sent (same buildKioskOrderPayload) — only WHICH method enum value (forced to 1=CASH_ON_DELIVERY). The snapshot logic is order-payload-driven, not payment-method-driven. Frozen at creation, NEVER overwritten. Compliant.

Plan B routes ALL kiosk orders to cash-on-delivery semantics → allocation happens at POS close (existing path used by today's kiosk-cash). Same monotonic per-branch gap-free behavior. NF525 chain bit-identical: BASELINE 'count=26 | last_hash=ca4ac1fdc208dae1' must still hold post-implementation. Compliant.
nf525_compliance_proof.production_boot_guard: POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE=false in production (AppServiceProvider.php:78-145). Plan B does NOT depend on simulation — the cash flow goes through PosCounterCollectModal which already has its own production-real cash drawer integration. Plan B is hardware-agnostic. Compliant.

future_migration_plan_a.transition_trigger: Owner signs acquéreur CB contract (SG Sogemonétique OR Worldline OR Viva.com — see feedback_titres_resto_conecs_2026.md). Terminals get wired to the bank. Currently SumUp blocks this — see feedback_no_sumup_existing_tpes.md.
future_migration_plan_a.code_change_required: ZERO. The kiosk CARD/TR paths are still present in KioskPaymentComponent (just v-if hidden) and FrontendOrderService backend handling is intact. To enable Plan A: set KIOSK_PAYMENT_ROUTE_ALL_TO_COUNTER=false in .env, run php artisan config:clear, rebuild bundles ONCE for the cached foodkingConfig blade injection.
future_migration_plan_a.owner_invariant_preserved: Owner verbatim: 'l'encaissement cash depuis borne vers caisse RESTE pour toujours'. Even in Plan A, kiosk-cash orders MUST still route to PosCounterCollectModal (cashier reconciles physical cash). The existing FrontendOrderService.php:206-207 logic (is_counter_deferred_kiosk_cash for CASH_ON_DELIVERY on a kiosk order) is permanent — it predates Plan B and is preserved in Plan A. Owner invariant is structurally locked into FrontendOrderService routing, not into the kiosk UI flag.
future_migration_plan_a.rollback_simplicity: If Plan A causes issue post-flip, set KIOSK_PAYMENT_ROUTE_ALL_TO_COUNTER=true (or remove env to use default), run config:clear. Instant rollback to Plan B in <30 sec.
future_migration_plan_a.intermediate_state: Owner can also adopt PARTIAL Plan A: keep flag true (force all-to-counter) but enable terminal-specific behavior at POS via PosCounterCollectModal — already supports mode='card' which can drive a wired terminal. Plan B is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE: the cashier-side wired-terminal flow is independent of the kiosk-side routing flag.

plan_b_flow: 2. Client clicks 'Payer' on cart → routes to KioskPaymentComponent
3. NEW: planBActive=true → either skip render of card/tr tiles OR auto-select cash + show 'Présentez-vous à la caisse' guidance
4. Client clicks confirm → submitOrder({paymentMethod:'cash'}) → payment_method=1 sent to backend
5. FrontendOrderService.php:206-208: is_counter_deferred_kiosk_cash=true → auto-accept (KDS receives) + status=PENDING_COUNTER + UNPAID
6. Client receives queue number, kitchen starts prepping
7. Client presents at counter → cashier opens PosCounterCollectModal (existing, Wave X-1) → picks cash OR card OR ticket OR mobile → physically encashes → confirms
8. Backend flips ps=PAID, allocates fiscal_sequence_no via FiscalSequenceService, audit_logs HMAC chain extended
data_flow_summary.plan_a_flow_post_transition: Identical to today's pre-Plan-B behavior: client picks card/cash/tr at kiosk → wired terminal handles card/tr inline → backend confirms paid at TPE callback → KDS notified. CASH flows still go counter-deferred (owner invariant).

risks.description: Cart 'Validate' button currently routes to /kiosk/payment. With UI tiles hidden, user lands on a near-empty screen. UX risk: client confusion ('did it work?').
risks.mitigation: Render an informative card: 'Paiement à la caisse — Validez pour générer votre numéro de commande, puis présentez-vous à la caisse.' Single i18n key kiosk.pay_screen.plan_b_notice. Already part of touch_matrix LOC budget for KioskPaymentComponent.

risks.description: Test suite may have specs asserting 3-method tile presence (e.g., tests checking data-testid='kiosk-payment-method-card').
risks.mitigation: Specs should be guarded with the flag too. Grep + update test specs as part of implementation. ~1-2 spec files likely affected. Outside the §7 frozen-zone.

risks.description: Analytics event 'payment_method_selected' fires per kioskAnalytics.track at line 353. With auto-cash, this event becomes uniform.
risks.mitigation: Acceptable — emit one 'payment_routed_to_counter' analytics event instead for Plan B transparency. Optional.

risks.description: TPE simulation tests / Playwright specs that drive the borne happy-path via CARD method will need updating.
risks.mitigation: Identify specs via grep, add flag-aware variant. Same release artifact.

risks.description: Network-offline (line 320, 358) and tpeWaiting logic become unreachable when planBActive=true. Dead code risk if not guarded.
risks.mitigation: Wrap network-offline check + TPE overlay with v-if="!planBActive" too. Cleaner than ripping them out (Plan A reuse).

owner_questions.question: Plan B default value: KIOSK_PAYMENT_ROUTE_ALL_TO_COUNTER=true by DEFAULT in V1 (safe, no env flip needed at deploy)? Or default=false with explicit opt-in env (more conservative, owner sets it after physical walk Monday)?
owner_questions.recommendation: Default=true so V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne resto auto-routes from day 1, matches owner verbatim. Owner Monday physical walk = no env flip required.

owner_questions.question: Plan B UI: hide CARD/TR tiles entirely (cleaner) OR render them disabled with grey-out + tooltip 'Disponible bientôt' (preserves spatial layout, communicates future evolution)?
owner_questions.recommendation: HIDE entirely. The screen becomes informative: total + 'paiement à la caisse' message + confirm button. Lighter UX, faster decision. Grey-out introduces visual debt.

owner_questions.question: Should kiosk confirmation screen wording also be updated? Currently shows 'Présentez-vous au comptoir', which already fits Plan B. Confirm no copy change needed?
owner_questions.recommendation: Confirm no copy change. KioskConfirmationComponent already aligns. Owner verifies on physical walk.

owner_questions.question: When acquéreur CB contract signed, owner wants kiosk-CARD active AND kiosk-cash still routed to POS. Confirm: flip flag to false → CARD/TR tiles reappear, cash remains routed via backend's existing is_counter_deferred_kiosk_cash. NO additional code needed?
owner_questions.recommendation: Confirmed by architecture: backend routing is permanent (FrontendOrderService.php:206-208), only the frontend UI gating changes with the flag. Plan A = single env flip.

owner_questions.question: Ticket Restaurant: Plan B routes via cashier? But ticket-resto via cashier requires manual stamp/punch (current French workflow). Confirm cashier will manually punch ticket-resto in PosCounterCollectModal mode='ticket' on physical paper?
owner_questions.recommendation: Owner-confirm. PosCounterCollectModal already supports mode='ticket' (Wave X-1). Workflow: cashier picks 'Ticket' mode → physically takes paper ticket → enters amount → confirms. Same as POS-only orders today.
